node.statement: Return to the polar factor: exact right unitality and X=u bold-dot h give ||u_delta(X)-X||=||u bold-dot J-u bold-dot h||=||u bold-dot (J-h)||<=(1+epsilon_r)||u||||a||. Using ||u||<=sqrt(16/15), epsilon_r<=1/16, and 1.3.2 gives ||u_delta(X)-X||<=(17/sqrt(15))*epsilon_r<=5*epsilon_r.
